summary: Verified updated VIP 'Show VIP on my main profile' rule end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (test_vip_show_on_main.py). Core new assertions: non-VIP viewer sees Lena with is_vip=false AND is_premium=true on both main-feed list and GET /api/profiles/{lenaId}; VIP viewer (admin) sees is_vip=true on both; vip_only + q=Lena search returns Lena for VIP viewer and not for non-VIP viewer; toggling show_on_main=true flips non-VIP viewer to is_vip=true, then restored to false and re-verified. Frontend: /browse?q=Lena shows profile-card-vip-badge for admin and only profile-card-premium-badge (no VIP) for plain_viewer. /profile/{lenaId} shows profile-view-vip-badge for admin and profile-view-premium-badge for plain_viewer. VipEditor note (vip-show-on-main-note) on Lena's /profile reads exactly: 'Off: only VIP members see your VIP status and can find you as VIP in search. Everyone else sees you as Premium.' Lena vip.show_on_main left as False (restored).
